items.title: Free Fuzz Week — seven days of Dig/Hunt on a public OSS repo
items.summary: From 23 November through 30 November 2026 the pool runs Dig or Hunt for free on a public open-source repository you bring. On 1 December we name the top 3 repos and pay 300 / 150 / 50 HMC on-chain.
items.impact: Three repositories per person. The repo must be public, with a clear license, and the campaign has to actually run. We rank the target and the run. A detector counter does not win. This is not a CVE promise.
items.action: Install from https://hackme.tech/downloads.html and place Dig or Hunt at https://hackme.tech/orders.html. Then register the repository at https://hackme.tech/fuzz-week.html — one form takes the repo, what to fuzz, the campaign id and an HMC wallet. Discord https://discord.gg/QMxSeaTSrQ, Telegram https://t.me/hackme_tech and support@hackme.tech still work if you prefer them.

items.title: 0.1.0-rc19 — Economics v2 live since block 550,000 · longer wallets · all packages
items.summary: Economics v2 has been live since block 550,000 (≈ 15 Nov 2026). Block reward 0.01 → 0.1 HMC (~288 HMC/day to miners), ~4-year halvings counted from genesis down to a permanent 0.002 HMC tail, no hard cap. Every paid order burns 5% (+5% platform fee). SUP is minted by the chain: 0.002 SUP per empty block, hard cap 21,000. New address format HMC- + 64 hex (full SHA-256 of your key); old 16-hex addresses keep working and are bound to their key — no automatic migration. Transfers carry chain_id hackme-mainnet-1 from the same height.
items.impact: Nodes older than rc19 do not know the v2 rules. Installers for Windows (Setup/ZIP), Linux tar, deb, rpm, Arch, HackMe OS ISO and a Docker image built from the tarball; a separate HackMe Orders profile for customers (also beside a miner via HACKME_ORDERS_PORT=8081).
items.action: Stay on 0.1.0-rc20 or newer (built-in updater keeps wallet, keys and .env; apt: sudo apt update && sudo apt install hackme-node). Check the dashboard shows 0.1.0-rc20 and note your long address. Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · RFC: https://github.com/jokeez/hackme/blob/main/docs/RFC_ECONOMICS_V2.md
